questions.quote: Indian rupee was devalued three times since 1947. 1. On 29th September, 1949. 2. On 6th June, 1966 3. On 1st July, 1991

en.q: According to the book, the Indian rupee has been devalued since 1947 how many times?
en.explanation: The devaluations were on 29 September 1949, 6 June 1966 and 1 July 1991.
